prompt: Read plan.md and turn it into tasks. Write tasks.json: a JSON array of {"id", "title", "depends_on": [ids]}, one task per plan step, no duplicate tasks, dependencies exactly as the plan states them, no cycles.

inputs.text:
# Plan: export of task history

1. Define the export file format (JSON lines, one task per line).
2. Add a database query that pages through task history; it needs the format.
3. Add the CLI command `export-history`; it needs the query.
4. Add an HTTP route for the export; it needs the query.
5. Write tests for the CLI command and the route.
6. Document the command and the route; this can start once the format is defined.

checks.run: node -e "const t=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('tasks.json','utf8'));if(!Array.isArray(t)||t.length<6)throw Error('expected 6 or more tasks');const ids=new Set(t.map(x=>x.id));if(ids.size!==t.length)throw Error('duplicate id');if(new Set(t.map(x=>x.title.toLowerCase())).size!==t.length)throw Error('duplicate title');for(const x of t)for(const d of x.depends_on)if(!ids.has(d))throw Error('missing dependency '+d);const seen=new Map();const visit=id=>{if(seen.get(id)===1)throw Error('cycle at '+id);if(seen.get(id)===2)return;seen.set(id,1);for(const d of t.find(x=>x.id===id).depends_on)visit(d);seen.set(id,2)};t.forEach(x=>visit(x.id))"

node -e "const t=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('tasks.json','utf8'));const by=n=>t.find(x=>new RegExp(n,'i').test(x.title));const q=by('query'),c=by('cli|command'),r=by('route|http');if(!q||!c||!r)throw Error('query, CLI and route tasks expected');if(!c.depends_on.includes(q.id)||!r.depends_on.includes(q.id))throw Error('CLI and route must depend on the query')"
